item.title: Marana rejects downtown project referendum petition; group behind the petition files lawsuit
item.description: A group that collected more than 2,000 signatures to put Marana's downtown development project on the ballot has filed a lawsuit against the town after its referendum petition was rejected.

item.title: Sheriff's Department confirms activity related to the Guthrie search resulted in no arrests
item.description: Pima County Sheriff Department is on scene and sealed off street two miles from Nancy Guthrie home. KGUN 9 crews are on scene.

item.title: No. 16 Texas Tech rallies to beat No. 1 Arizona 78-75 in OT for Wildcats' second straight loss
item.description: JT Toppin scored eight of his 31 points in a dominant overtime performance and No. 16 Texas Tech sent No. 1 Arizona to its second straight loss, shocking the Wildcats 78-75 on Saturday.
